notes.title: Patch 1.04 Released
notes.content:
Patch 1.04 has been released.
[list]
[*]Improved Online Multiplayer menus to get a more direct access to open games.
[*]In online multiplayer added the ability to play another stage with the same team without having to rematch.
[*]Improved loading times.
[*]Additional languages now supported: French, Italian, Spanish, German.
[*]The Weekly Stage is now open from Tuesday to Sunday every week. 
[*]The Mana, Ice and Missile tower are now slightly more efficient.
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Released
notes.content:
Patch 1.03 has been released.

[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list][*]New feature: Weekly Stage.
>The layout for this special stage will change every week.
>Clearing this stage unlocks new masks and shells. (24 total)
[*]Improvements to online matching menu.
>Can now search for any stages from the lobby.
[*]Added Photo Mode.
>Pause the game to remove the UI and  take screenshots.
[*]Added separate ranking boards for online multiplayer and local multiplayer.
[*]New feature: Random Stage.
>Randomly generated stage that is different every time you play.
[*]Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Released
notes.content:
Patch 1.01 has been released. This patch adds several features that have been requested by fans.

Feature changes:
1) Zoom is now adjustable.

2) Quick toggle added to see the entire playable map at once. 

3) Local co-op warp removed. The camera will now auto-zoom to keep both players on screen.

4) Local co-op tower menu readability is improved. They now slide out from the player that opened them, and they will always be on "your" side of the screen. 

4) Toggle to show all towers' current XP and level.

5) Cloud saves

6) Faster network game joining. The game now directly loads into the lobby.

7) The game immediately saves when you buy or equip a mask or carapace.

New control overview.
Keyboard/Mouse
Middle mouse wheel - zoom
Q key - toggle full map view
Left Ctrl - toggle tower info

Gamepad
LB/RB - zoom
LT - toggle full map view
Left stick press - toggle tower info

notes.title: [5/3/2018]Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
In order for as many player as possible to enjoy PixelJunk™️ Monsters 2 Demo we added support for the the following items below.
- Simple keyboard & mouse control have been added
    - The controls are :
- Up : W 
- Down: S
- Left : A
- Right: D
- Confirm / Action : F OR Left Click
- Cancel / Pause : Escape
- Jump : Space
- Camera Scroll in Top view: Right Click (hold)
- An option to quit the game has been added to the title screen.
- Basic graphic settings have been added to the Option menu
    -The available options are as follow: 
             - Fullscreen mode
             - Resolution
             - Render Scale
